referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The reference is a specialty coffee e-commerce store. A slim announcement bar sits above a transparent header. The opening is an image-led hero with a short headline and a shop action. A featured blends grid shows product cards with imagery and prices. Single-origin and subscription sections follow. A bestsellers band and a customer quote reinforce trust. A footer newsletter captures email for offers and local events. Warm off-white surfaces with a friendly rounded sans define the look.

requiredSignatureElements.description: Translate the slim announcement bar with a single offer.
Translate the product card grid with client-cleared items.
Translate the subscription band with one clear action.

prohibitedPatterns: reuse Marigold brand, words, logo, photographs, prices or trade dress
invent awards, prices, locations, staff or outcomes
copy a source section or source code
generic repeated cards that erase the storefront rhythm
low contrast or inaccessible mobile actions
acceptanceChecks: Opening is image-led with a visible primary shop action.
Featured blends read as a product grid, not a generic card wall.
Subscription and bestsellers each keep one decisive action.
At 390 px product grids stack without horizontal overflow.
No source brand, photograph, review, or unsupported claim is reused.

review.notes: Official business page rendered HTTP 200 at both viewports. Recaptured with the supported scroll-settled full-page capture; desktop and mobile images verified to show product grids and all sections. Owned source; retained as internal design-mechanics reference only.
